newsitem.title: USA: NYS panel approves $1.3 bln of agency bond sales.
newsitem.headline: NYS panel approves $1.3 bln of agency bond sales.

text.p: The New York State Public Authorities Control Board approved bond issues and loans that total nearly $1.285 billion for a variety of state authority projects, including a big debt sale by the Dormitory Authority.
The Control Board, which approved the projects on Wednesday, gave the Authority the go ahead to issue approximately $792 million of bonds for the acquisition, construction and financing of projects.
A Dormitory Authority official was not immediately available to provide any further details about the offering.

The Control Board also signed off on a Dormitory Authority $274 million offering of revenue bonds for the Mental Health Services Facilities for construction, refinancing and refunding some bonds issued in 1987.
And the Dormitory Authority was cleared to issue approximately $22 million of bonds for the Library for the Blind and Physically Handicapped.
Almost $21 million of bonds will be issued for a New York State home for Veterans, with the proceeds used for refinancing and refunding an escrow deposit.
The New York State Urban Development Corp received approval for issuing $175 million of revenue bonds for building and renovating prisons.
The Control Board also approved a Environmental Faciltiies Corporation approximately $3.3 million loan for the Upper Mohwak Valley Regional Water Finance Authority.
